source: Read-only analysis of installed GCloud.dll and bounded local original-client tests

transport_header.native_control_reader_version_source: the third 16-bit word at packet offset 4, copied to connection+0x17dc and passed to the 0x188070 dispatcher

ready_0x6002.version_12_added_fields: four 32-bit extension words after the 33-byte prefix
ready_0x6002.interpretation: The old 33-byte ready body used the wrong control layout version. The official 64-byte ciphertext is consistent with the 49-byte version-12 structure; adding a padding block to a 33-byte body is rejected by the installed native decryptor. This establishes a structural correction, not yet original-client login acceptance.
